pages.text: The Lumber Axe is a broad chopping tool. It can fell entire trees or gather wood in a wide range. A tree is only detected if it has leaves on top.
$(l)Properties$()$(br2)- Requires a Tool Forge$(br)- Fells whole trees in one swing$(br)- Trees must have leaves on top to be felled$(br)- 3x3x3 area mining$(br)- Effective on wood
